# hyperannotatR

**hyperannotatR** provides multi-layer region-of-interest annotation for
hyperspectral imaging (HSI), including spectral cubes, band views,
spectral extraction, and associated display rasters. ROI geometries,
masks, resumable sessions and exports support HSI annotation and
classification.

Cell and nucleus annotation, segmentation, correction, training and
review for microscopy belong to **segmantR**. Its independent drawing
canvas and mask workflow do not require hyperannotatR. Generic raster
and geometry APIs remain available for HSI previews and interchange
compatibility.

The R package was renamed from `annotatR` to `hyperannotatR`; load it
with [`library(hyperannotatR)`](https://github.com/CTTIR/hyperannotatR).
The `at_*` function names and saved object classes are retained. The
hosted source repository is `CTTIR/hyperannotatR`.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("CTTIR/hyperannotatR")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(hyperannotatR)

# Read a bundled example image and build a project with one annotation layer.
img <- at_example_image("tissue")
proj <- at_project(img, at_layer("regions", labels = c("tumour", "stroma")))

# Add regions of interest.
proj <- proj |>
  at_add_roi("regions", at_roi_rect(120, 150, 260, 290, label = "tumour")) |>
  at_add_roi("regions", at_roi_circle(400, 120, 60, label = "stroma"))

at_rois(proj)[, c("roi_id", "label", "area_px")]
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   roi_id        label  area_px
#>   <chr>         <chr>    <dbl>
#> 1 roi_000000001 tumour  19600 
#> 2 roi_000000002 stroma  11292.

# Rasterise to a labelled mask (the "Schablone") and write it with a legend.
mask <- at_mask(proj, type = "labelled")
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".tif")
at_write_mask(mask, path)             # also writes <path>.legend.json
```

``` r

at_plot_overlay(proj)
```

![](reference/figures/README-overlay-1.png)

## Supported formats

| Format | Backend | Package required | Pyramid | Spectral |
|----|----|----|----|----|
| PNG / JPEG | `raster` | magick | no | no |
| TIFF, incl. pyramidal and multi-channel | `tiff` | tiff | yes | multiplex |
| qptiff, OME-TIFF | `ometiff` | RBioFormats + xml2, windowed reads | yes | multiplex |
| Cubert `.cu3s` | `cuvis` | cuvis.r + CUVIS SDK | no | yes |
| ENVI cube (BSQ/BIL/BIP) | `envi` | base R, windowed reads | no | yes |
| Diaspective Vision TIVITA | `tivita` | base R, declared profile or sidecar | no | yes |

A TIFF is treated as spectral only when wavelengths are declared.
[`at_bands()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_bands.md),
[`at_hsi_meta()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_hsi_meta.md)
and
[`at_read_stats()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_read_stats.md)
report band wavelengths and gaps, value units, calibration and transform
digests, and the bytes actually read. The ENVI, TIVITA and OME readers
read windows from the file; the raster, TIFF and Cubert backends decode
the whole image when it is opened, so it must fit in memory.
[`at_image_capabilities()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_image_capabilities.md)
reports which applies to an image.

The `raster` backend converts samples to a 0–255 display convention and
does not preserve original high-bit-depth intensities. The quantitative
TIFF, OME and ENVI readers keep raw samples; format and optional-reader
limits are documented in
[`vignette("images-and-backends")`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/articles/images-and-backends.md).
Extraction never applies plot contrast stretches. It reports selected,
finite and nonfinite counts, with an explicit `nonfinite` policy and
declared spectral units.

## The mask workflow

A **mask** is the central output artifact: a binary, labelled, or
multi-class integer raster derived from your annotations, exportable at
any pyramid level and self-describing via a sidecar JSON legend. Masks
feed segmentation, classification, and spectral-extraction pipelines in
Python, ImageJ, QuPath, or R. See
[`vignette("masks")`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/articles/masks.md)
for the pixel-coverage contract and downstream consumption.

## The annotation app

``` r

# Launch the batch annotation app over a queue of images:
at_annotate(at_example_session(5))
```

Iterate through an image queue, draw multi-layer ROIs, watch the mask
render live, and export everything in one pass — with resumable sessions
and keyboard-first throughput.
[`at_app()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_app.md)
returns the same app as a `shiny.appobj` for embedding and testing.

## Working with qupflowR

hyperannotatR exchanges annotations with the qupflowR package through a
versioned, hash-inventoried contract.
[`at_interop_capabilities()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_interop_capabilities.md)
reports which profiles this installation supports; the file (I0) and R
API (I1) profiles are supported, while direct app control (I2) and
embedding (I3) stay *planned* until they are qualified against a real
qupflowR client.

``` r

dest <- file.path(tempdir(), "handoff")
receipt <- at_export_qupflowr(proj, dest)            # QuPath GeoJSON, masks, manifest, integrity
report <- at_import_qupflowr(dest)                    # verified, namespaced, never runs analysis
patch <- at_stage_qupflowr(proj, report)              # diff; reviewed ROIs become conflicts
committed <- at_commit_qupflowr(patch, idempotency_key = "review-42")
```

[`at_training_export()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_training_export.md)
writes leakage-free, grouped deep-learning datasets with integer masks
and full provenance, and
[`at_training_import()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_training_import.md)
stages model predictions for review. An optional loopback control
service
([`at_control_start()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_start.md),
protocol `annotatr-control-v1`) lets a partner process read state and
events and send typed commands to a running app. See
[`vignette("partner-interop")`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/articles/partner-interop.md).

## Related work

Unlike QuPath, the ImageJ ROI Manager, napari, or Annotorious,
hyperannotatR is R-native and script-first, focuses on hyperspectral
cubes and their display rasters, and treats the batch **mask** export as
a first-class, reproducible artifact.

## Acknowledgements

hyperannotatR builds on [Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/), the
[`sf`](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/) and
[`stars`](https://r-spatial.github.io/stars/) packages.

## Use of LLM tools

Where applicable, LLM tools were used for narrowly defined,
non-authorial tasks: copyediting, prose refinement, Markdown/LaTeX
formatting, boilerplate scaffolding (such as CI configurations and build
scripts), and code refactoring. Tools included [Chat
AI](https://kisski.gwdg.de/leistungen/2-02-llm-service/), the KISSKI
(GWDG) service, and self-hosted **Mistral Small (24B, Apache-2.0)**
served through a local **vLLM architecture** on an Ubuntu Linux
workstation with Intel processors and NVIDIA GPUs. The self-hosted model
ran locally, with no data sent to third parties.

All scientific claims, methodological choices, analyses, interpretations
and conclusions remain the authors’ own. Where applicable, LLM-generated
material must be reviewed and revised before inclusion, and references
must be verified against their DOI, arXiv ID or ISBN.

Local software setup: vLLM with Python/PyTorch, plus R and RStudio.

## Branding

Editable R sources and regeneration instructions are in
[tools/branding](https://github.com/CTTIR/hyperannotatR/tree/main/tools/branding).

## Images and backends

Read images and register formats.

- [`at_read_image()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_read_image.md)
  : Read an image
- [`at_tile()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_tile.md)
  : Read a tile from an image
- [`at_dims()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_dims.md)
  [`dim(`*`<annot_image>`*`)`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_dims.md)
  : Image dimensions at a pyramid level
- [`at_n_levels()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_n_levels.md)
  : Number of pyramid levels
- [`at_n_bands()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_n_bands.md)
  : Number of bands (channels)
- [`at_bands()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_bands.md)
  : Band (channel) table
- [`at_wavelengths()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_wavelengths.md)
  : Band centre wavelengths
- [`at_is_spectral()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_is_spectral.md)
  : Is the image a spectral cube?
- [`at_is_pyramidal()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_is_pyramidal.md)
  : Is the image pyramidal?
- [`at_pixel_size()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_pixel_size.md)
  : Physical pixel size
- [`at_meta()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_meta.md)
  : Image metadata
- [`at_backend_list()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_backend_list.md)
  : List registered image backends
- [`at_backend_get()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_backend_get.md)
  : Get a registered backend
- [`at_backend_detect()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_backend_detect.md)
  : Detect the backend for a file
- [`at_backend_register()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_backend_register.md)
  : Register an image backend
- [`at_tivita_profile()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_tivita_profile.md)
  : Declare a TIVITA SpecCube layout profile
- [`at_cubert_export_envi()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_cubert_export_envi.md)
  : Export a Cubert measurement to a portable ENVI cube
- [`at_image_capabilities()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_image_capabilities.md)
  : Inspect the effective reading capabilities of an image
- [`at_close_image()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_close_image.md)
  : Release an image handle

## Geometry

Transforms, set operations, predicates, and validity.

- [`at_transform()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_transform.md)
  : Transform an ROI between pyramid levels using real image dimensions
- [`at_roi_rescale()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_rescale.md)
  : Rescale an ROI between pyramid levels
- [`at_roi_buffer()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_buffer.md)
  : Buffer an ROI
- [`at_roi_simplify()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_simplify.md)
  : Simplify an ROI
- [`at_flip_y()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_flip_y.md)
  : Flip an ROI's y-axis
- [`at_snap()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_snap.md)
  : Snap ROI vertices to a grid
- [`at_clamp()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_clamp.md)
  : Clip an ROI to image bounds
- [`at_roi_union()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_setops.md)
  [`at_roi_intersect()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_setops.md)
  [`at_roi_difference()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_setops.md)
  [`at_roi_symdiff()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_setops.md)
  : Set operations on ROIs
- [`at_roi_ring()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_ring.md)
  : Ring (annulus) along an ROI margin
- [`at_roi_contains()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_contains.md)
  : Test whether points fall inside an ROI
- [`at_roi_overlaps()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_overlaps.md)
  : Test whether two ROIs intersect
- [`at_roi_distance()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_roi_distance.md)
  : Distance between two ROIs
- [`at_rois_overlap()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_rois_overlap.md)
  : Pairwise ROI overlaps within a layer
- [`at_check_geometry()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_check_geometry.md)
  : Check the geometry of every ROI in a project
- [`at_fix_geometry()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_fix_geometry.md)
  : Repair the geometry of a project
- [`at_check_containment()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_check_containment.md)
  : Check cross-layer containment

  : Read ROIs from a CSV with WKT geometry

## Partner interoperability

The versioned qupflowR contract - capabilities, manifests, handoffs,
staging and commits.

- [`at_interop_capabilities()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_interop_capabilities.md)
  : Partner interoperability capabilities
- [`at_interop_manifest()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_interop_manifest.md)
  : Build a partner interop manifest
- [`at_annotation_revision()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_annotation_revision.md)
  : Annotation revision token
- [`at_export_qupflowr()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_export_qupflowr.md)
  : Export annotations as a qupflowR handoff directory
- [`at_import_qupflowr()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_import_qupflowr.md)
  : Import a qupflowR handoff or neutral interchange file
- [`at_stage_qupflowr()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_stage_qupflowr.md)
  : Stage partner changes against a hyperannotatR project
- [`at_commit_qupflowr()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_commit_qupflowr.md)
  : Commit a staged partner patch

## Training datasets

Leakage-free deep-learning datasets and staged prediction import.

- [`at_training_export()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_training_export.md)
  : Export a DNN training dataset
- [`at_training_check()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_training_check.md)
  : Check a training dataset
- [`at_training_import()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_training_import.md)
  : Import model predictions as staged annotations

## Control service

The optional loopback annotatr-control-v1 service.

- [`at_control_capabilities()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_capabilities.md)
  : Control protocol capabilities
- [`at_control_start()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_start.md)
  : Start the local control service
- [`at_control_stop()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_stop.md)
  : Stop a local control service
- [`at_control_close()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_close.md)
  : Close a control service connection
- [`at_control_connect()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_connect.md)
  : Connect to a running control service
- [`at_control_state()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_state.md)
  : Read the state of a control service
- [`at_control_events()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_events.md)
  : Read control events after a cursor
- [`at_control_command()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_command.md)
  : Send a typed control command
- [`at_control_request_status()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_control_request_status.md)
  : Resolve the outcome of a control request

## Shiny application

The batch annotation app and canvas widget.

- [`at_app()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_app.md)
  : Build the annotation app as a Shiny app object
- [`at_annotate()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_annotate.md)
  : Launch the batch annotation application
- [`at_canvas()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas.md)
  : An annotation canvas widget
- [`atCanvasOutput()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/atCanvasOutput.md)
  : Shiny output for the annotation canvas
- [`renderAtCanvas()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/renderAtCanvas.md)
  : Render an annotation canvas in Shiny
- [`at_canvas_proxy()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_proxy.md)
  : A proxy for an existing annotation canvas
- [`at_canvas_set_annotations()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_set_annotations.md)
  : Replace the annotations on a canvas
- [`at_canvas_set_tool()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_set_tool.md)
  : Set the active drawing tool
- [`at_canvas_set_band()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_set_band.md)
  : Set the displayed band or RGB triple
- [`at_canvas_set_overlay()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_set_overlay.md)
  : Overlay a mask on the canvas
- [`at_canvas_fit()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_fit.md)
  : Zoom the canvas to a bounding box
- [`at_canvas_set_selection()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_canvas_set_selection.md)
  : Highlight selected ROIs on a canvas
- [`at_tile_source()`](https://cttir.github.io/hyperannotatR/reference/at_tile_source.md)
  : Build a tile-source descriptor for the canvas
